### Periods and comparability

| Period | Basis | Note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1998 | consolidated | FY2002 issuer highlights. Full FY1998 audited statements and FY1997 opening detail were not verified. Negative equity makes conventional ROE uninformative. |
| 1999 | consolidated | The audited equity statement shows a January opening deficit of IDR 25.524 trillion and closing equity of IDR 5.121 trillion after recapitalization. Their average was negative, so the conventional ROE is omitted. The archive also discloses a tax benefit. |
| 2000 | consolidated | BCA audited archive presents January–October and November–December around the quasi-reorganization. The cash flow bridge reconciles at October 31; income totals agree with the rounded FY2002 highlights. Historical returns span the reorganization. |
| 2001 | consolidated | FY2002 consolidated comparative. |
| 2004 | consolidated | FY2005 audited comparative. |
| 2006 | consolidated | Audited 2006 statement and note for exact pretax income, balance and EPS inputs. Scanned pages checked against the published totals. |
| 2007 | consolidated | The archived FY2007 as-filed parent equity is used in FY2007 ROE. FY2008 ROE uses its restated opening equity from the FY2008 annual report. |
| 2010 | consolidated | FY2011 audited comparative. |
| 2012 | consolidated | FY2013 audited comparative. |
| 2013 | consolidated | As filed. The FY2014 returns use the restated opening balances from the FY2015 annual report. |
| 2014 | consolidated | FY2015 audited comparative. Opening and closing balances use the same restated basis. |
| 2016 | consolidated | FY2016 annual report financial statements. Audit opinion is on PDF p. 595. |
| 2017 | consolidated | FY2018 audited comparative where available. |
| 2020 | consolidated | FY2020 as filed, with fixed-asset purchases taken from the FY2021 comparative, which separates right-of-use asset purchases. EPS uses the 2021 split basis. |
| 2021 | consolidated | 1:5 stock split. Earlier reported EPS has been aligned to this share basis. |
| 2023 | consolidated | Uses the dedicated FY2023 audited filing. Group profit and parent profit are distinct. |
| 2024 | consolidated | FY2025 audited comparative. ROA and ROE use FY2023 closing balances. |
| 2025 | consolidated | FY2025 audited filing. BCA reports no material prior-period effect from adoption of SFAS 117 and 109. |
| 2025-03 | consolidated | Three-month profit from the March 2026 statement comparative. |
| 2025-06 | consolidated | Six-month profit from the June 2026 statement comparative. |
| 2025-09 | consolidated | Nine months through September. Income and weighted-average shares come from the 2026 comparative and balances from the September 2025 filing. |
| 2025-10 | bank only | Bank only. January–October net profit agrees with the statement of financial position current-year earnings; the publication does not include a cash-flow statement. |
| 2026-03 | consolidated | Three months through March. Unaudited. |
| 2026-06 | consolidated | Six months through June. Unaudited. |
| 2026-09 | consolidated | Nine months through September. Unaudited. |
| 2026-10 | bank only | Bank only. January–October net profit agrees with the statement of financial position current-year earnings. Compared with the same period and basis in 2025. |

<a id="rules"></a>

## Rule assessments

| Rule | Disposition | Evidence and gaps | Calculations |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 · gross-margin | not_applicable | BBCA earns a spread on lending and funding, plus fees and other income. Bank-only NIM narrowed from 5.8% to 5.7%. Track NIM alongside fees, credit costs, and operating efficiency. Formula ((revenue - cost_of_revenue) / revenue) * 100. [BCA audited FY2025 · PDF 9–10](https://www.bca.co.id/-/media/Feature/Report/File/S8/Laporan-Diaudit/2026/20260127-audited-financial-statement-bca-31-december-2025-english-combined.pdf#page=9) [BCA FY2025 annual report · PDF 16](https://www.bca.co.id/-/media/Feature/Report/File/S8/Laporan-Tahunan/2026/20260212-BCA-AR-2025-EN.pdf#page=16) |  |
| 2 · cost-of-goods-sold | not_applicable | The consolidated income statement reports interest, insurance, operating expenses and credit impairment. The inventory cost formula does not describe those activities. Formula beginning_inventory + inventory_costs_added_during_period - ending_inventory. [BCA audited FY2025 · PDF 9–10](https://www.bca.co.id/-/media/Feature/Report/File/S8/Laporan-Diaudit/2026/20260127-audited-financial-statement-bca-31-december-2025-english-combined.pdf#page=9) [BCA audited FY2025 · PDF 7–8](https://www.bca.co.id/-/media/Feature/Report/File/S8/Laporan-Diaudit/2026/20260127-audited-financial-statement-bca-31-december-2025-english-combined.pdf#page=7) |  |
| 3 · gross-profit | not_applicable | Consider IDR 85.55T of net interest and sharia income and IDR 26.31T of other operating income separately. They have different drivers and are not an inventory-based gross profit. Formula revenue - cost_of_revenue. [BCA audited FY2025 · PDF 9–10](https://www.bca.co.id/-/media/Feature/Report/File/S8/Laporan-Diaudit/2026/20260127-audited-financial-statement-bca-31-december-2025-english-combined.pdf#page=9) |  |
| 4 · operating-profit | not_applicable | Interest is part of core banking income. The pretax bridge uses net interest and sharia income, net insurance, other income, impairment and operating expenses. Formula gross_profit - operating_expenses. [BCA audited FY2025 · PDF 9–10](https://www.bca.co.id/-/media/Feature/Report/File/S8/Laporan-Diaudit/2026/20260127-audited-financial-statement-bca-31-december-2025-english-combined.pdf#page=9) [BCA FY2025 annual report · PDF 16](https://www.bca.co.id/-/media/Feature/Report/File/S8/Laporan-Tahunan/2026/20260212-BCA-AR-2025-EN.pdf#page=16) |  |
| 5 · sga-to-gross-profit | not_applicable | BCA’s personnel and administrative expenses support recurring banking operations. Its bank-only cost-to-income ratio was 30.7%, versus 31.3% in 2024. Formula (selling_general_and_administrative_expense / gross_profit) * 100. [BCA audited FY2025 · PDF 9–10](https://www.bca.co.id/-/media/Feature/Report/File/S8/Laporan-Diaudit/2026/20260127-audited-financial-statement-bca-31-december-2025-english-combined.pdf#page=9) [BCA FY2025 annual report · PDF 16](https://www.bca.co.id/-/media/Feature/Report/File/S8/Laporan-Tahunan/2026/20260212-BCA-AR-2025-EN.pdf#page=16) |  |
| 6 · rd-to-gross-profit | not_applicable | IT and digital investment contribute to transaction capacity, but the consolidated statement lacks a separate comparable R&D and gross-profit pair. Formula (research_and_development_expense / gross_profit) * 100. [BCA audited FY2025 · PDF 9–10](https://www.bca.co.id/-/media/Feature/Report/File/S8/Laporan-Diaudit/2026/20260127-audited-financial-statement-bca-31-december-2025-english-combined.pdf#page=9) [BCA FY2025 annual report · PDF 15–16](https://www.bca.co.id/-/media/Feature/Report/File/S8/Laporan-Tahunan/2026/20260212-BCA-AR-2025-EN.pdf#page=15) |  |
| 7 · depreciation-to-gross-profit | not_applicable | Fixed assets are depreciated and include right-of-use assets. Review the asset note and use a multi-year purchases-to-earnings comparison for the capital burden. Formula (depreciation_expense / gross_profit) * 100. [BCA audited FY2025 · PDF 69–70](https://www.bca.co.id/-/media/Feature/Report/File/S8/Laporan-Diaudit/2026/20260127-audited-financial-statement-bca-31-december-2025-english-combined.pdf#page=69) [BCA audited FY2025 · PDF 13–14](https://www.bca.co.id/-/media/Feature/Report/File/S8/Laporan-Diaudit/2026/20260127-audited-financial-statement-bca-31-december-2025-english-combined.pdf#page=13) |  |
| 8 · interest-to-operating-income | not_applicable | Funding interest is a banking input cost. Compare interest expense with earning assets, deposit mix, and NIM. Stress deposit repricing and credit costs together. Formula (interest_expense / operating_income) * 100. [BCA audited FY2025 · PDF 9–10](https://www.bca.co.id/-/media/Feature/Report/File/S8/Laporan-Diaudit/2026/20260127-audited-financial-statement-bca-31-december-2025-english-combined.pdf#page=9) [BCA audited FY2025 · PDF 71–72](https://www.bca.co.id/-/media/Feature/Report/File/S8/Laporan-Diaudit/2026/20260127-audited-financial-statement-bca-31-december-2025-english-combined.pdf#page=71) [BCA FY2025 annual report · PDF 16](https://www.bca.co.id/-/media/Feature/Report/File/S8/Laporan-Tahunan/2026/20260212-BCA-AR-2025-EN.pdf#page=16) |  |
| 9 · net-profit-margin | calculated | Group net earnings divided by consolidated operating income including insurance as presented by the issuer for FY2025. The bank operating income variant excludes net insurance from its denominator and has its own calculation records. Formula (net_earnings / revenue) * 100. The net banking denominator differs from the gross revenue basis typical for nonfinancial companies. <a id="research-gaps"></a>

## Remaining research gaps

BCA’s audited equity statement confirms the FY1998 year-end deficit carried into FY1999. The FY1999 recapitalization restored positive closing equity, but average equity was negative, making conventional ROE unsuitable. The FY1998 cash-flow, tax and asset-return calculations still need the full statements and FY1997 opening assets. A ten-year capex ratio before FY2008 also needs contemporaneous fixed-asset purchases and earnings. [BCA FY2002 annual report · PDF p. 2, financial highlights. Operating income is net interest income plus other operating income.](https://www.bca.co.id/-/media/Feature/Report/File/S8/Laporan-Tahunan/AR-2002.pdf#page=2) [BCA audited FY1999 and FY2000 split periods (Global Reports mirror) · Statement p. 10, 1 January 1999 equity deficit](https://studylibid.com/doc/1976703/pt-bank-central-asia-tbk-dan-anak-perusahaan) [BCA audited FY1999 and FY2000 split periods (Global Reports mirror) · Statement pp. 4–6, closing balance sheets](https://studylibid.com/doc/1976703/pt-bank-central-asia-tbk-dan-anak-perusahaan)

The audited financing cash flows and BCA dividend records support zero cash dividends paid in calendar 2000. The fiscal FY2000 payout still needs the 31 May 2001 shareholder resolution or equivalent evidence. A full-calendar 2000 shareholder return is unavailable because BBCA listed during the year. FY2026 annual results await publication. [BCA audited FY1999 and FY2000 split periods (Global Reports mirror) · Statement pp. 11–12, cash-flow subtotals and opening/closing cash](https://studylibid.com/doc/1976703/pt-bank-central-asia-tbk-dan-anak-perusahaan) [BCA dividend and entitlement history · Regular-market entitlement and payment dates. Amounts adjusted for the 2004 and 2008 splits where still needed.](https://www.bca.co.id/en/tentang-bca/Hubungan-Investor/Informasi-Saham/Riwayat-Deviden) [BCA annual report FY2002 · PDF p. 171, basic EPS, general reserve and cash-dividend notes](https://www.bca.co.id/-/media/Feature/Report/File/S8/Laporan-Tahunan/AR-2002.pdf#page=171) [BCA share listing chronology · listing and splits table](https://www.bca.co.id/en/tentang-bca/Hubungan-Investor/Informasi-Saham/Kronologis-Pencatatan-Saham) [BCA October 2026 publication · PDF 1–3](https://www.bca.co.id/-/media/Feature/Report/File/S8/Laporan-Bulanan/2026/20261113-laporan-keuangan-publikasi-bulanan-oktober-2026-eng.pdf#page=1)

Owner earnings and replacement value depend on estimates of maintenance reinvestment and replacement costs. Look-through adjustments require material unrecognized investee earnings and distribution taxes. Portfolio rules need investor inputs. Market-strategy rules need an investable, point-in-time market dataset including delisted firms and trading costs. [BCA audited FY2025 · PDF 13–14](https://www.bca.co.id/-/media/Feature/Report/File/S8/Laporan-Diaudit/2026/20260127-audited-financial-statement-bca-31-december-2025-english-combined.pdf#page=13) [BCA audited FY2025 · PDF 69–70](https://www.bca.co.id/-/media/Feature/Report/File/S8/Laporan-Diaudit/2026/20260127-audited-financial-statement-bca-31-december-2025-english-combined.pdf#page=69) [BCA audited FY2025 · PDF 18–19](https://www.bca.co.id/-/media/Feature/Report/File/S8/Laporan-Diaudit/2026/20260127-audited-financial-statement-bca-31-december-2025-english-combined.pdf#page=18) [BCA audited FY2025 · PDF 139–145](https://www.bca.co.id/-/media/Feature/Report/File/S8/Laporan-Diaudit/2026/20260127-audited-financial-statement-bca-31-december-2025-english-combined.pdf#page=139)
